candidate_family.threshold_meaning: causally completed maximum decline from the highest coordinate high inside the 120 completed sessions preceding gap formation

economic_hypothesis: A clean downward true gap is more likely to mark late-stage forced liquidation when it forms only after a deep, already-mature decline. The subsequent below-L washout and first MA5 reclaim may then monetize a reflexive repair toward, but not into, the gap.
post_2023_scope: No post-2023 signal, feature, threshold, or selection row. Existing V4R1 post-cutoff rows may be inherited only for pre-2024 trade closure.

order: minimum absolute distance from 50 selected signals per year
